defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its meet-in-the-middle state stores per-half totals but does not correctly account for partnership contributions crossing between the two halves, producing incorrect combined scores.
It enumerates every k-subset and recomputes degrees and partnership scores, which is exponential in n and times out for n up to 46.
Its bitmask meet-in-the-middle computation combines partial selections without correctly preserving all cross-half partnership effects, so its validity test is wrong.
